points.why: Says a good fit to calm history says little about stress behavior, that tuned parameters can hide structural gaps, and that recalibrating would give a model that fits both events and is still structurally wrong.

Names the missing retry loop, explains why calm history couldn't reveal it, recommends adding it and stress-testing with slow-dependency and retry-storm scenarios, but never compares runs with the loop on and off.
No link-by-link review with client engineers or SREs, no independent reviewers, and no record of which parameters were tuned; it only says to use retry parameters measured from code and logs.

Gives a trust criterion (reproduce the failure from measured behavior) and ties it to go/no-go, but sets no explicit refutation test and runs no sensitivity analysis on retry, backoff and timeout assumptions.

pitfalls.why: Explicitly says recalibration alone won't validate the model.
